scope.summary: Prove the installer E2E contract suite is honestly green on the post-T6.1 tree, and harden npm_release_channel_is_retired so a retired npm publish channel re-added under ANY workflow filename is caught.
out_of_scope: The Homebrew/winget/npm removal itself (T6.1, bead .3.1, already closed); this close only proves the survivor suite asserts a current, true contract on that post-retirement tree.
A real online install from a published GitHub release (explicit no-claim boundary; that is R.7).
The Windows durable-state install step (T10.3); the Windows installer PSSA/dry-run lane (job windows-installer) remains separate and unaffected.

Any .github/workflows/ci.yml edit: the tier-A `test` job's `cargo test --workspace --all-targets` step already builds and runs tests/installer_e2e.rs, so the `installer` job does not need a duplicate scoped step.
Other agents' uncommitted Rust edits present in this shared checkout (reported by the scaffold as 49 dirty paths outside this scope); excluded from tree_clean by the scaffold's scope computation.

entry_points.name: retired brew/winget and binstall contract (binstall_metadata_valid_and_no_distribution_manifests_ship, cargo_binstall_metadata_matches_release_assets)
entry_points.trace: Both tests green at source.sha. binstall metadata retained ([package.metadata.binstall] + windows-msvc override); retired packaging/homebrew, packaging/winget, scripts/render_distribution_manifests.sh asserted absent; .github/workflows/release.yml asserted free of distribution-manifests/render_distribution_manifests/Homebrew/homebrew/winget.

limitations: No CI job URL: this implementer session must not push (AGENTS.md; the operator prompt forbids push). The tier-A job/step names are recorded (job `test`, step `cargo test --workspace --all-targets`; job `installer`, step `installer offline smoke`); the green run at the HEAD commit is expected but not observed from GitHub.

The scoped suite and the offline smoke ran in the shared multi-agent checkout, so the Rust compile saw other agents' uncommitted edits to oraclemcp-config/core/db/oraclemcp-main. Those files do not touch installer scripts, docs/install.md, workflows, or Cargo.toml binstall metadata, and the suite's assertions read those surfaces directly; tree_clean=true is computed over this bead's single in-scope path at source.sha.

The offline smoke used the host x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu debug binary (target/debug/oraclemcp), not the musl target the CI installer job builds (target/x86_64-unknown-linux-musl/debug/oraclemcp); the smoke's built-artifact path is exercised either way, but the exact CI musl binary was not run locally.

The planted-negative runs temporarily create a workflow file under .github/workflows/ and remove it; a concurrently running agent's test could in principle observe the file in that sub-second window. It was created and removed only for the two demonstration runs.
